role: Prospective new-recording validation within DSEC, not a new sensor/dataset or universally independent city sample.
selection: One first _a segment from every previously unused recording group in the official detection test list: exclude interlaken00, already used in development; keep all remaining seven groups, without output-dependent replacement.
calibration: Use existing frozen Thun-only secondary thresholds unchanged, and separately evaluate retrospective actual whole-sequence FP points using the predeclared replay algorithm. No subgroup threshold tuning.
primary_prediction: I_motion=(R_EMA-R_activity)_low-(R_EMA-R_activity)_high <0 for RVT; report all recording effects and mean/median, with assumptions/uncertainty, whether favorable or not.
sampling: Fixed census of these seven unused official-test recording groups. Availability failures and incomplete support remain in the status/report; no outcome-dependent additions, deletions or early success stopping. Every available complete clip and eligible native query is used.
interpretation: Labels are public in the detection extension. Results are local evaluation of named test recordings, not an official challenge submission or proof of geographic/sensor generalization. Official group IDs are working clustering units; shared cities/sessions remain limitations.
